content:
I’m pleased to share that my teammate Bhagwath Reddy Yatam and I represented BITS Law School, Mumbai in the 1st edition of the Virtual Mediation Advocacy Competition organised by IAMC Hyderabad and SettleWiseNow, in which we finished off as Semi-Finalists, placing Top 4 out of 42 teams. Further, in Round 1 (Negotiation-Deal Making), we were recognised as the Best Deal-Makers, an award sponsored by CrestLaw Partners. 

The competition progressed over 1.5 months with participants from all over India. The competition was intense with 3 training sessions and five Rounds of actual deal making and mediation. Meandering through these five rounds till the Semi Finals, we were able to experience the mediation and negotiation process in depth. This competition granted us an opportunity to enhance our strategy with each step, while developing a grasp over mediation advocacy, drafting and deal-making. 

Though we couldn’t progress to reach the Final rounds as we had aspired to, this competition indeed served to be a motivation for our future endeavours. We would like to thank Dean, Dr. Vishwas H Devaiah for his motivation and Professor Mohammad Umar for his guidance throughout.
comment: Mediation competitions reveal that outcomes often depend less on knowing rules and more on reading interests, managing uncertainty, and building trust. Those negotiation instincts become invaluable long after the competition ends.
